import argparse
import ast
import json
from func_adl_servicex_xaodr25 import FuncADLQueryPHYSLITE
from servicex import deliver, ServiceXSpec, Sample, dataset
from servicex.configuration import Configuration

# Ordinary retained jets are a transport control, not the nominal displaced jets.
query = (FuncADLQueryPHYSLITE()
    .Select(lambda e: {'ei': e.EventInfo('EventInfo'), 'jets': e.Jets()})
    .Select(lambda c: {
        'run': c.ei.runNumber(), 'event': c.ei.eventNumber(),
        'lb': c.ei.lumiBlock(), 'bcid': c.ei.bcid(),
        'jet_pt': c.jets.Select(lambda j: j.pt()/1000.0),
        'jet_eta': c.jets.Select(lambda j: j.eta()),
        'jet_phi': c.jets.Select(lambda j: j.phi()),
    }))
